# ScopeLimit

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

One contributing policy's limit on where its unknown settings apply, in
an effective policy (`UnknownPolicy::scope_limits`). It holds when
every scope of `all_of` matches and, if `any_of` is not empty, one of
its scopes matches.

Appears at: `/policy/unknown/scope_limits`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all_of` | array of [`Scope`](scope.md) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The contributing policy's `policy.scope`, if it has one. At most one scope: the width of an entry is never more than its source policy's, so the authored limits apply to it unchanged. |
| `any_of` | array of [`Scope`](scope.md) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The contributing policy's `unknown.scopes`. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
